text: AAA similarity criterion: If the corresponding angles of two triangles are equal, then their corresponding sides are in the same ratio and the triangles are similar. It is enough to know two pairs of corresponding angles are equal, because the third pair must then be equal by the angle-sum property of triangles.

text: For a point P(x,y), x (the abscissa) records the signed horizontal displacement from the y-axis and y (the ordinate) records the signed vertical displacement from the x-axis: right/up are positive and left/down are negative. Thus points on the x-axis have form (x,0), while points on the y-axis have form (0,y). The coordinates are directed values, not unsigned distances.
